AFTERWARDS..."Interview with AccardiThe #Cagliari sporting director is waiting for #Juve, and so is his gem."We know that there is a lot of interest in him, he can do like #Barella. Right now, however, he must work a lot with us: this is not a stepping-stone club". The urgency for the bianconero winter mercato is a left-back. #Vicario toward a permanent buyout. #Nico has extended until 2030: 4 million per year.[Front Page TuttoSport]

✍️ "#Juventus is one of the most active clubs in terms of contract renewals, seeking to secure its key players and reduce the annual amortization on the economici balance sheet.▫️​Nico #González: His agent, Alessandro Moggi, has already finalized the renewal.The Argentine has been one of the best starters of the season, extending his contract until 2030 with a salary of ~€4M annually. ▪️​#DouglasLuiz: His contract expires in 2 years, but the club plans to extend it until 2030, primarily to improve the amortization structure.▫️​Pierre #Kalulu: #Juve has been negotiating for months to renew him until 2031 and considers him untouchable (they rejected an approach by #ManchesterUnited in the summ

🇮🇹🔛 #Juventus is accelerating for #Romano, aiming to beat the competition as early as January: first phone contacts have taken place between #Carnevali and Giulini. The bianconeri would be ready to offer around €25M, but it might not be enough. #Cagliari would like to postpone everything until the summer. #Inter is also still in the race, looking especially at June. #Milan, on the other hand, appreciates him, but for now has not initiated concrete contacts.[Daniele Longo - CM•COM via @juventusinsidernews]

📋🧐 "The lineup that #Spalletti tested for #Cagliari is: Vicario; Kalulu, Bremer, Lucumí, Celik; Douglas Luiz, Sarr; Conceição, McKennie, Nico González; Kolo Muani. However, you never know with the bianconero coach: a little something could change because these are just the very first trials."[Romeo Agresti - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]
👀🧤 "#Juventus is following Bart #Verbruggen, the starting goalkeeper for #Brighton."[Romeo Agresti - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]

ℹ️💸 "Nico #González will earn €3.6/3.7M + bonuses to get close to €4M. From an accounting perspective, the positive impact will be limited: the annual cost will drop from €11.5M to €9.7/9.8M, with the possibility of reducing it further through bonuses. This represents a saving, but not enough to free up a significant economic margin."[Romeo Agresti - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]

🇫🇷🆙 "#Thuram went back to Hauteville, a facility near Lyon, to continue his rehabilitation surrounded by the right qualified people. It is the best path towards recovery. He is working and regaining his physical condition under the supervision and consultation of Sonnery-Cottet."[Romeo Agresti - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]

🚑 "Jeff #Ekhator is progressing well in his recovery process and could return in November.The #Juventus forward has already resumed on pitch exercises with the ball under the supervision of a dedicated fitness coach.The club wants to proceed with utmost caution, keeping in mind past injuries and relapses.The progress is encouraging, but zero risks."[@romeoagresti on @ilbianconerocom via @PuebloJ]

NICO GONZALEZ RENEWS UNTIL 2030!Nico Gonzalez has signed a new contract! The Argentine and Juventus have come to an agreement on a new deal that will run until June 30, 2030.The new contract confirms the desire to build on the journey that began in the summer of 2024 when Nico first arrived in Turin. Since then, the 28-year-old has made a total of 45 appearances and scored seven goals for Juventus, making a significant contribution at the start of this season too, with two goals from five appearances so far.His playing style brings unpredictability and tactical options to the forward line as the Bianconeri face a busy season, combined with the experience and character that make him a valuabl
Nico Gonzalez is here to stay! ✍️The Argentine signs a new contract with Juventus until 2030! [Juventus]

🧐❗️#Juventus is evaluating new attackers, concerned about the lack of impact from #KoloMuani and #Woltemade. Before making a move, the management wants to assess #Ekhator, but in the meantime they are monitoring three profiles: #Retegui, #Balogun and #Raimondo. If the ex #Genoa were to leave to play and find continuity, the search could be accelerated.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇦🇷🔐 #Juventus is ready to lock down Nico #González until 2030, signature today this afternoon and salary adjusted to €3.6M. His positive impact over the first months, along with #Spalletti's trust, who considers him an important asset, were decisive. The renewal allows for the spreading of amortization, reducing the annual economic weight on the balance sheet.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "#Juventus continues to follow #Palmisani closely. He has already been observed by scouts, who will continue to monitor him.For now, the situation is only one of monitoring, scouting and informal contacts.However, there are no negotiations yet: they consider him very promising and want to follow his development."[@FabrizioRomano on YouTube via @PuebloJ]
Tomorrow, Saturday October 10, Luciano #Spalletti will speak in a press conference at 4:00 PM on the eve of #CagliariJuve 🎙️ @junews24com[Marco Baridon]
